answer: Require each identity to show transactions with 50 distinct established counterparties over 90 days, forming a trellis of real relationships checked against the network graph. One fake costs about $250 in fees and favors to build fifty genuine links, and the cost rises faster than linearly because established counterparties charge more as demand grows and fake clusters sharing counterparties are flagged — a zephyr-light identity with no anchor in real trade cannot pass.
